req.title: Update task
req.statement: The system shall update mutable fields of the task and return the updated object when PUT /tasks/{task_id} is called with a valid body.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the update functionality of the task management API. It includes tests for positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage. The tests are crafted to catch common mutation operators by asserting exact values, testing both sides of comparisons, and covering boundary conditions.

tests.name: test_update_task_positive
preconditions: Task with id 1 exists in the database
actions: Send PUT request to update task with id 1
expected: Task with id 1 is updated with new title
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put(
    "/tasks/1",
    json={"title": "Updated Task Title"}
)

assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()["title"] == "Updated Task Title"
assert response.json()["id"] == 1

tests.name: test_update_task_negative
preconditions: Task with id 999 does not exist in the database
actions: Send PUT request to update non-existent task with id 999
expected: Error message indicating task not found
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put(
    "/tasks/999",
    json={"title": "Non-existent Task"}
)

assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json()["detail"] == "Task with id 999 not found"

tests.name: test_update_task_boundary
preconditions: Task with id 2 exists in the database
actions: Send PUT request to update task with id 2 using maximum length description
expected: Task with id 2 is updated with new description
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_description = "X" * 500
response = client.put(
    "/tasks/2",
    json={"description": max_length_description}
)

assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()["description"] == max_length_description
assert response.json()["id"] == 2
